entries.description: Added Publish* properties to AccessHarvester.Cli.csproj (PublishSingleFile=true, PublishTrimmed=false documented rationale, IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true, EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true). RID and SelfContained kept publish-time only via the script.
Authored tools/publish/publish.ps1. dotnet publish --self-contained --runtime win-x64 to publish/win-x64/. Manual --help validation OK; binary 36.9 MB.

Two consecutive publishes produced byte-identical SHA256 0CC72857AC2678E809404A57D7FFA90F09E8FC5066CBFADE8265BD50FC3624DA. No timestamp normalization needed — .NET 10 Deterministic=true default plus compressed single-file already deterministic.
Added /publish/ to .gitignore so the self-contained binary is not committed.

dotnet build PASSED (0 errors, 323 pre-existing warnings). dotnet test: 2 pre-existing ParseSuccessReport failures + 4 pre-existing Integration failures (line-ending mismatch: committed LF, working-tree CRLF due to git autocrlf with no .gitattributes). Confirmed pre-existing by re-running on pristine HEAD with my changes stashed. Out of scope for this session — flagged for a follow-up tree-amendment.

Cross-provider verification via query(model='gemini-pro', task_type='session-verification') — fallback after GPT-5.4 returned 429 Too Many Requests three times (verifier-failure escalation ladder step 2).
Routed analysis: next-orchestrator recommendation for Session 2 per Step 8 / Rule #17. Supersedes the Step-3.5 placeholder that named a non-existent model (verifier Round 1 Minor).

Step 3.5 acknowledged: Session 1 actuals already recorded at Session 1 closeout; Session 2 next-orchestrator recommendation already routed at Session 1 Step 8 and lives at next-orchestrator-recommendation-session-2.md. Session 2 is last — no Session 3 recommendation to author.

Authored tests/AccessHarvester.Integration/TestSupport/PublishedArtifact.cs. Resolves repo root via new RepoPaths.LocateDirectoryContaining("AccessHarvester.sln") and probes publish/<rid>/AccessHarvester.exe. TryLocate returns null on absence so [SkippableFact] tests can skip cleanly.

Authored tests/AccessHarvester.Integration/Cli/PackagedBinarySmokeTests.cs — 4 [SkippableFact] tests: no-args/usage, --help, parse against 01-simple-validation.bas, generate-docs against examples/northwind-output.json. Process invoked directly so the packaged exe is exercised (not the test-bin per-project copy). 90s timeout covers single-file cold-start native-lib extraction.

Authored docs/harvester/install.md (install + invoke guide, versioning convention, verify-an-install smoke commands, constraints). Updated README.md CLI section with a link to the install doc and dropped the now-inaccurate 'three subcommands' lead. Synthesis prose authored in-conversation per the 'orchestrator's model matches routing target' Convention; Opus-as-orchestrator does not route synthesis to itself.

Added --version / version flag to AccessHarvester.Cli.Program. Prints 'AccessHarvester <semver> (schema v1.0)'. Harvester semver pulled from AssemblyInformationalVersionAttribute on the Pipeline assembly with the '+commit-sha' SourceLink suffix stripped. Schema-version literal '1.0' pinned (must match DatabaseManifest.SchemaVersion). PrintUsage mentions --version. Bootstrap test theory covers both --version and 'version' forms.

dotnet build PASSED (0 errors, 323 warnings — all pre-existing CA1416 warnings on Windows-only APIs in test files). dotnet test PASSED across 10 test assemblies: TranslationProbe(9), Characterization(131), Vba.Parser(69), Vba.Grammar(294), Sql.Grammar(85), Vba.Resolver(400), Pipeline(375), SymbolDb(70), AccessHarvester.Tests(436+2 skipped synthetic), Integration(31 — includes new VersionFlag bootstrap theory and 4 PackagedBinarySmokeTests). No failures. Re-published publish/win-x64/AccessHarvester.exe (36.9 MB) so smoke tests exercise the post-version-flag build; --version on the packaged binary prints 'AccessHarvester 1.0.0 (schema v1.0)' correctly.

Cross-provider session-verification (Round 1, fallback per escalation ladder step 2): GPT-5.4 returned three 429s; queried gemini-pro directly. Prompt includes mandatory prose-before-JSON lead and the required-JSON-block schema per Conventions.
Routed change-log.md via route(task_type='summarization', max_tier=1) -> gemini-flash. Phase 4 closer end-of-set change log.

Routed next-session-set-recommendation.md via route(task_type='analysis') -> gemini-pro. Plan-driven: confirms Phase 4 closes with this set, recommends maintenance posture; surfaces carry-overs for human decision.
